description: Use this when someone asks what listed companies have announced today or recently, across the market or on one exchange. Give it an exchange code (NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, ASX, TSX…) or nothing. Returns the newest releases with date, company and 6ix.com link; pass the answer's nextCursor as cursor for the ones before them.

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

exchange.description: Exchange code, e.g. NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, ASX, TSE, TSX

name: get_latest_news_releases

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

title: Latest news releases
